description: Persistent Story Highlight albums for a public profile — id, title, cover, owner. Flat 1 credit. Costs 1 credit. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh.

url.description: Instagram profile URL, @handle, or username. Omit when userId is set.

userId.description: Numeric Instagram user ID. Prefer when known — skips handle→ID resolve. When only userId is set we reverse-resolve the username so the WPI / profile-HTML shelf can still run.

name: instagram_highlights
